sourceReferences.manifestAlgorithm: At actual remains availability, assign remainsId/bodyId/deathTime and all prior damage/custody/claims. Roll one size pool (Tiny1, Small1d2, Medium1d4, Large2d4,Huge4d4) under the accepted finite framework. Resolve each native category availability d100 once. NEW allocation: order eligible categories by original occurrence; if more than one, roll uniform starting ordinal 1..N and distribute the one pool round-robin from there, respecting each actual anatomical cap and measured remaining mass. No eligible category means pool yields nothing. Record fixed unit IDs/allocation before worker choice; do not redirect forfeited quantities. One actual unit cannot belong to two categories. No exceptional additive drop is inferred here.
sourceReferences.selectionAndTime: Choose categories from the complete available manifest. Full time is this exact source time; partial time is ceil(fullMinutes*chosenCategories/availableCategories), minimum1minute. All unselected ordinary categories are forfeited when work begins. Hurry halves that actual required time with upward minute rounding and disadvantage. No Craftsman/Spell Scribe research/manufacturing discount shortens harvest.
sourceReferences.workAndInterruption: NEW harvest-only physical progress completion: record actual exclusive active seconds of usable removal work; safe pauses retain only physically usable progress, clocks continue and real damage can destroy work/stock. No crafting incorporation stabilization or study-phase clock is imported. An interrupted unfinished attempt resumes the same selected finite units and original receipts, not a new yield roll. Completed failure exhausts that selected attempt. Another worker requires genuine access/skill and inherits existing physical progress, never duplicated hours or fresh material.
sourceReferences.resolution: Core four-degree extraction check. Success recovers selected intact allocated units. Critical success additionally saves at most one predeclared damaged/recoverable selected unit within the same anatomical cap; no nonexistent bonus. Failure ruins the highest-reference selected unit (actual tie choice recorded), recovers none, and exhausts selection. Critical failure ruins all selected units, with only actual declared hazard; absent one, real1d4 minor physical accident to lead. No new retry or repeated corpse conversion.
sourceReferences.custodyAndAftermath: Award actual identified lots once at completion, with source occurrence, unit ID, quantity, weight, current condition, clock, owner/claimant and custodian kept separate. Real carried gear is separate and not duplicated by harvest. Humanoid/celestial remains require actual consent/lawful authority/explicit dark-path source. A destroyed or Null-disabled living body is not automatically eligible remains. Magical projections, companions and Simulacra keep their own accepted no-farming/lifecycle procedures.
sourceReferences.noGuaranteedEquivalence: Every global material/recipe-name comparison is retained separately. Effect. Grants +1 to Fishing checks. On a successful catch, gain 1 additional unit of usable meat or material; tagged bait preferentially attracts flora-aligned creatures.

operational.text: On one eligible ordinary provision catch check, this actual participating Tackle offers +1 in equipment.leather-task-enhancement; choose the strongest independently eligible modifier once. It offers 1 in equipment.fishing-extra-recovery, separately compared at secure capture among sources that qualified at the check and still qualify. The first secure capture records one recovery evaluation for that physical creature, including zero; later recapture cannot raise it. Authorize only available disjoint real reserve units for later lawful harvesting, never immediate meat or extra creatures. Its one selectable attraction affinity is Flora; choose one source before one finite, weighted response allocation within 30 feet of connected water path. Local availability, perception, response and physical fit remain required. The three choices are independent; tags never combine automatically. The complete item must have positive structural HP, remain unsuppressed and unmelded, and actually participate in the registered method. It is reusable, but supplies no bait/chum or new opportunity. Neither case grants a separate activation, RP, concentration, charges, proficiency, AC candidate, resistance, food credit or bonus on harvesting, repair, research, creation or combat.
